body: Monitored containment is the continuous, signed measurement of an AI system's risk posture across a defined axis set — explicitly not a claim that the system is ever provably isolated from harm. The Council of AI applies monitored containment through three structures: (1) a 14-axis measurement board (detection, care, denial, governance, provenance, and others) against 19+ frontier models; (2) an Ed25519-signed manifest frozen at a timestamp that binds every axis score to a fixed board state; (3) a verified measurement credential that links any single observation back to the manifest under which it occurred. The distinction matters: monitored containment (measurement continuously audited) versus provable isolation (an unattainable proof claim). The verified measurement credential is manifest-bound, independently verifiable, and never a vendor assertion. Naming: Council of AI / Council City / Council Signal ONLY. Never SOVOS / SOV / sov6 / JEEVES / Sovereign Temple / Liquid-KAN / Maternal Covenant / OpenPatent / defonos.io in any public-facing document.
